status: New exploratory finite-boundary quantum realization, not a full cubic-lattice photon or QED claim
idea: Restore quantum electric links to the correlated N=2 Hubbard molecule instead of integrating its excitations out. Matter hops shift electric flux, which changes subsequent matter propagation. The only flux restoring dynamics is generated by Peierls matter hopping; no bare magnetic energy is introduced.
candidate_branches: Exact compact one-plaquette quantum-link Hamiltonian with physical Gauss basis (executed candidate)
Multi-momentum collective oscillator feedback built from published exact ring poles (alternative not executed; cannot supply nonlinear excited-state scattering without restoring matter vertices)
selection: The compact realization retains nonlinear Peierls transport, virtual double occupations and photon-flux recoil on one joint state, while the quadratic alternative would duplicate the supplier's already executed linear feedback.
H: sum_e E_e^2/(2 epsilon_b) + U sum_s n_s_up n_s_down + sum_e,sigma [-t cdag_(e+1),sigma c_e,sigma U_e + h.c.], U_e raises E_e by 1
gauss: E_e-E_(e-1)=-rho_e; rho_e=n_e_up+n_e_down-1/2. E0,E2 integer; E1,E3 integer+1/2. Hopping e->e+1 raises E_e by 1 and preserves this constraint.
domain: N=2, four spinful sites in xy square, fermionic CAR basis imported from supplier hop; all configurations retained. Orthogonal electric cutoff projection |E_e|<=L+1/2, L=2,3,4. No claim of compact-rotor unitarity at cutoff boundary. Half-integer electric topological sector is an explicit new boundary choice.
state: Recomputed ground and complete eigenbasis of the joint finite Hamiltonian, not the isolated LoopMatter ground or cubic quadratic vacuum. Frozen comparator recomputes isolated N=2 matter state with U_e=1, omits electric dynamics and is labelled a different approximation.
derivatives: External phase alpha_e,sigma multiplies each forward hopping by exp(i alpha). J_e,sigma=-dH/dalpha=-i(T-Tdag); C_e,sigma=d2H/dalpha2=-(T+Tdag). Mixed edge/spin contact vanishes; physical electromagnetic source sums spins. Spin-resolved columns are current diagnostics, not independent physical photons.

schema.basis: ordered (fermion_bits, twice_electric_tuple), arrays exposed by CoupledMolecule
schema.vertex: CoupledMolecule.vertex(q): complex array [4,dim,dim], index=2*spin+polarization. J(q)=sum_e R_xy(q)_e,i F(q)_i,pol J_e,spin
schema.response: response(qout,qin,z): [4,4], <C> + retarded chi of receiver J(qout)^dagger and source J(qin), both positive and negative poles, all non-ground states
schema.raman: raman(qout,qin,omega,eta,final,ground_only=False): [4,4], exact finite-state two-leg transition tensor; final index in SAME joint eigenbasis
schema.time: time_motion(q): coherent real current kick followed by autonomous exp(-iHt); rows t,<electric energy>,<double occupancy>,<total H>
schema.frequency: hbar=1; energy/frequency in hopping t; z=omega+i eta; eta positive resolution, not physical dissipation
schema.momentum: q in inverse lattice spacing a=1; supplier midpoint-link plane-wave convention and lattice-transverse frame qhat=2sin(q/2). qout differs from qin; anchored molecule absorbs momentum, no COM mass or translational recoil fabricated
schema.units: e=a=hbar=t=1, U=4t, epsilon_b=1 in inverse-energy units for dimensionless E, current and contact in t for dimensionless phase, two-leg tensor in t
schema.matrix_readout: For physical EM polarization tensor sum both spin indices; resolved 4x4 matrix retains opposite-spin virtual processes. No spin-flip or magnetic Pauli source has been inserted.

Cutoffs 2,3,4 expose electric-boundary effects without claiming rigorous convergence.
